rust_summary: dispenser item behaviours (`native_dispense_item`) and `native_dispense_default` for a plain drop.
doc_summary: dispenser item behaviours (`native_dispense_item`): a server hook receives the dimension, dispenser position, facing and selected stack, before any vanilla behaviour, for mod or vanilla items. Leave its answer `None` for vanilla; `Some(None)` empties the slot; `Some(Some(stack))` writes that remainder without consuming again. Return `Some(native_dispense_default(dimension, pos, facing, stack.clone()))` to drop one item normally, including items with a special vanilla behaviour. Handled actions get the normal click and smoke once. Droppers are unaffected. Bundles need "hooks": @API:dispenser_behaviour@.
